recommendation: Quote delivery as a link plus a PDF: the customer always gets both; acceptance, requested changes and terms are captured on the link or recorded by staff from a reply; the owner is told immediately when a customer responds; sending is checked for spam-filter risk and never labelled Sent until it is
dependencies: D-025; ADR for email delivery; UXB-61; legal review of electronic acceptance; amendment A20

recommendation_short: Written, visible roll-up rules along PPO's hierarchy
recommendation: Written, visible roll-up rules along PPO's hierarchy: how dates, status and readiness roll up from visit to work order to job pack to project, and from site to organisation; each parent names the child that drives its date or status; links between projects shown on the programme view

recommendation_short: Correction paths for closed, posted and issued records
recommendation: Correction paths for closed, posted and issued records: a visible amend or reverse action that keeps history (who, when, why); no silent deletion; undo for reversible actions. PPO makes no stock adjustments and supply observations already record the actor and a mandatory reason, so stock needs no new rule unless PPO later records counts or adjustments
on_main_note: work-order scopes, job packs and field reports change by new revision with history (compare saved version, immutable revision, report amend); closed records show no visible reverse action

recommendation_short: Export exactly the view on screen and make every figure reconcile
recommendation: Export exactly the view on screen and make every figure reconcile: each register and report exports its current filtered view to Excel or CSV with definitions and an as-at stamp; each cue or total drills to the rows that add up to it
on_main_note: Projects, Leads, Deals and Job packs export the current page or filter to CSV, but Organisations, Equipment and Work orders do not; My Work cues drill to their rows, other totals do not

recommendation_short: In-app feedback with visible outcomes
recommendation: In-app feedback with visible outcomes: a "suggest a change" control on every page that records the page, record and role; a list staff can see with each suggestion's status; delivered suggestions marked in plain-language release notes

recommendation_short: Equipment data-plate capture
recommendation: Equipment data-plate capture: a photo of an asset's data plate proposes make, model and serial fields for the technician to confirm, with manual entry always available
dependencies: ADR for AI provider (image text recognition); UXB-53 proposal pattern

recommendation_short: One draft-approve-send communications record shared by dispatch notices
recommendation: One draft-approve-send communications record shared by dispatch notices (carrying UXB-14's carrier and tracking), visit confirmations and project updates: each message drafted from PPO records, approved and published by a named person, delivered by email or SMS according to the contact's recorded preference, with any portal link optional (UXB-89), kept on the record it concerns, and never labelled Sent until it is
dependencies: D-025 (draft paper in PR #525); a delivery ADR for SMS and email; the Microsoft mailbox pilot; UXB-14 (split from it on 16 Oct); pain points 2 and 3; UXB-89

recommendation_short: Backup currency where people look
recommendation: Backup currency where people look: the equipment record and register show each controller's backup state from EQ-08 evidence in words (current; older than the latest configuration change; none recorded; recovery not tested); each backup records the controller software release it was taken on as its own field, because a restore needs the same release; closing a visit on a controller after an I/O change or software update prompts for a PostChange backup or a recorded reason; the backup file is referenced where SharePoint holds it, never with credentials

recommendation_short: Settings changes and temporary overrides recorded per visit
recommendation: Settings changes and temporary overrides recorded per visit: each setting a technician changes in a grower's controller is captured as an item with old value, new value, reason, technician, visit and time, viewable on the asset by item or by person and listed in the service report the grower receives; a temporary override is recorded with its intended revert time, and the visit stays open until it is reverted or handed to a named grower contact; PPO records what was done in the vendor's tool and never writes to the controller

recommendation_short: Grower consent and access record for controllers and data
recommendation: Grower consent and access record for controllers and data: per site and vendor system, record who at the grower granted access, to which Powerplants people, for what purpose, from when and until when, and how it is revoked; show it on the site and asset and check it before remote diagnosis or any monitoring; treat alarm logs, settings and readings as farm data in the Australian Farm Data Code's sense (transparency, explicit consent, no secondary use without consent, deletion of identifying data on request); never store the grower's vendor credentials

recommendation_short: After-alarm service record before any telemetry
recommendation: After-alarm service record before any telemetry: when a grower or technician reports an alarm, record the alarm and system, when it fired, who the controller notified, when Powerplants was contacted, whether it was diagnosed remotely or needed a visit, the cause found, the follow-up work and whether thresholds or recipient lists should change; label each alarm's source (technician-entered, forwarded email or dialler message, vendor app viewed under granted access); let the grower export the trail; never re-deliver alarms or act as the alarm path of record
dependencies: Narrows UXB-66 to a record PPO can keep today; UXB-87; UXB-36; D-027
on_main_note: SV-08 unbuilt; CX-03 conditional

recommendation_short: Customer messages email and SMS first
recommendation: Customer messages email and SMS first: every customer-facing event (quote issued, visit booked or changed, job complete, report ready, project update) goes by email or SMS according to the contact's recorded preference, plain and light enough for poor coverage, with any portal link optional and sign-in from it low-effort; nothing can be done only in the portal; phone stays a first-class route; portal adoption is measured against stated preference, not assumed

recommendation_short: Lead time and parts availability stated
recommendation: Lead time and parts availability stated: each quote line or package states its expected lead time with source and as-at date, with long-lead imports flagged; project updates and dispatch notices list deliveries against those lead times, and a slip is reported proactively by the named owner with its reason and new date

recommendation_short: Pre-season alarm and contact check
recommendation: Pre-season alarm and contact check: a maintenance-plan task, offered before peak heating or cooling, that confirms with the grower who receives each critical alarm and what they are expected to do, tests the notification path and lists alarms that fired without action for threshold review; the result is recorded on the site with who confirmed it and when; PPO checks the grower's set-up and never takes over alarm delivery

recommendation_short: Ask Powerplants' own growers before building grower-facing channels
recommendation: Ask Powerplants' own growers before building grower-facing channels: short interviews or a survey on preferred channel (phone, email, SMS, WhatsApp, portal), willingness to use a portal, quote format, after-hours expectations, who receives alarms on site, and on what terms they would grant controller access; results recorded as evidence for UXB-60, UXB-87, UXB-89 and UXB-90
